Hi Lina — thanks for the note and for getting this started. Short answers below, followed by the documents we need to clear the purchase-account (PA) and enable a PO.

Requirements (what will clear the conditional hold):
- Completed W-8BEN-E signed by an authorized signatory. Notarization is not required by default, but we will accept a remote-notarized copy if there is any question about signer authority.
- Supporting evidence of US TIN for the US branch — either the IRS EIN confirmation letter, an equivalent bank letter showing the TIN, or a copy of the W-9 for the US branch.
- If the signatory on the W-8BEN-E is not listed on your certificate of incumbency, please provide a corporate resolution or signatory letter.

We can provisionally create a purchase-account ID so you can reference it on invoices; final PO issuance will occur after tax verification. I created a temporary PA: PA-7731. Use that on the invoice for tracking.

Upload path: https://vendor-portal.redwood.com/upload/PA-7731 (preferred)
DocuSign alternative: https://docusign.net/DocID/abc123

Next steps for your team:
1) Attach the signed W-8BEN-E + bank letter (PDF) to the portal link above.
2) If you have the EIN confirmation letter (IRS CP 575 or similar), attach it.
3) If signatory differs from corporate filings, include a short signatory attestation.

Kimberly — looping you for compliance acceptance and to confirm whether remote-notary is acceptable for this account under our current policy.

Hi Lina — thanks for sending the files, they arrived and I reviewed them quickly. A few points to close the loop so your procurement activation isn't delayed: 

1) Acceptance: the signed W-8BEN-E + bank letter are acceptable initial evidence. Notarization is optional — we can accept the current PDF and complete our internal verification.

2) TIN formatting: the bank letter's numeric TIN (12-3456789) is fine. We will cross-check that against the IRS file. 

3) Outstanding item: please upload the certificate of incumbency or corporate resolution that names Clara Ito (CFO) as an authorized signatory. You mentioned it is uploaded — I could not find it in the portal; if you could re-upload to the same PA-7731 path that would be ideal.

4) Conditional activation and PO timing: we have provisionally opened the purchase-account PA-7731 for invoicing (you can send invoices against that ID). Final PO issuance (formal PO number and payment terms) will be triggered once the signatory attestation and TIN verification are complete. Expected timeline: 24–72 hours after we receive the incumbency doc and confirm the TIN.

5) Expedited option: if you need a faster path, we can accept a notarized W-8BEN-E via DocuSign (remote notary) and an email confirmation from your bank's compliance contact that includes the TIN — that typically shortens our verification to same day.

Please reply with the incumbency doc or confirm you'll upload; I'll monitor the portal and let Jordan know when we clear the verification so Ben can issue the PO.

Best,
